The agent should detect this and either refuse, ask the user to drop one shape, or propose substituting disks for ellipses.

If you haven't called setup_simulation_problem_tool yet, please call it now. Do not proceed to planning, execution, or analysis — your task is complete after setup.

Agent asks the user to clarify (e.g., drop ellipse for disk, or drop capsule) instead of silently calling the setup tool with an incompatible mixture.

metadata.expected_failure_mode: ellipse + capsule incompatible in 2D HPMC integrator
